hook: Twelve love letters vanished for 238 years resurfaced today.

sections.voiceover: Twelve love letters vanished for 238 years resurfaced today.
sections.visual_cue: Animated timeline showing 12 letters disappearing and reappearing after 238 years.

sections.voiceover: In 1785, scientist Jean‑André Mongez wrote twelve letters aboard La Pérouse before the fleet vanished. What did Mongez reveal to Louise Victoria Le Cloustier of Rouen?
sections.visual_cue: Old ship illustration, modern hand holding letters, map of Rouen with a question mark.

sections.voiceover: Yet Louis XVI asked for news of La Pérouse on his execution day.
sections.visual_cue: Portrait of Louis XVI with a speech bubble asking about La Pérouse.

sections.voiceover: Mongez’s letters to Louise detail the expedition’s daily hardships. Twelve letters resurfaced after 238 years, giving voice to the lost fleet.
sections.visual_cue: Pages of letters, portrait of Louise, ghostly ship fading into sea.

sections.voiceover: Now twelve letters finally speak after 238 silent years.
sections.visual_cue: Fade to a stack of letters with a ticking clock overlay.
